hits.title: Farmer Mac Announces Effective Date for Completion of CEO Succession
hits.snippet: WASHINGTON, June 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Federal Agricultural Mortgage Corporation (Farmer Mac; NYSE: AGM and AGM.A), the nation's secondary market provider that increases the accessibility of financing to provide vital liquidity for American agriculture and rural infrastructure, announced today that its Board of Directors has approved July 1, 2026, as the effective date for Zachary N. Carpenter, currently President and Chief Operating Officer, to assume the role of CEO, succeeding Bradford T. Nordholm. Mr. Nordholm will transition to serve as senior advisor to the CEO with the honorary title of CEO Emeritus through September 30, 2026.
